payload.blocks: Only doors phase 12d2 (door severity values), the plan's last open phase; the plan closes after it.
payload.headline: Stage and activate a release with 764dbb6a1, and run one authority render? My confined session cannot.

parts.cause: Staging and activating a release, and running fgos authority render, both need an unconfined session. No lead:SUPERVISOR session is live on this machine to do them.

options.cost: About 10 minutes of build plus two commands.
options.does: You build, stage and activate a release from main at or after 764dbb6a1, then run `fgos authority render` and land the result.
options.gain: 12d2 resumes on the next wake and the doors plan closes.
options.harm: None beyond a few minutes of your time.
options.label: You run both commands

options.does: You start the unconfined session once; I send it both commands and read back the result.
options.gain: Future confined chores route there without asking you.
options.label: Start an unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR

options.does: The doors plan stays running with 12d2 parked until a release happens for another reason.
options.harm: The doors plan stays open and the boundary doc stays out of sync.
options.label: Hold 12d2

parts.recommendation: You run both commands: it is the shortest path to closing the doors plan.

scope.allows: One release stage and activation from main, and one authority render landed as docs.
scope.forbids: Any code change or any widening of phase 12d2's scope.

parts.what: Doors phase 12d landed (764dbb6a1). Phase 12d2 writes the severity value into every door row, and it is parked because the active release does not yet carry the crate change that accepts that field. Separately, docs/platform/component-boundary.md no longer matches the model on main (fgos authority render --check fails).
